objective: Validate own enumerable string fields under JavaScript trim semantics without rewriting values.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Object.values, every and trim remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Nonblank field validation is common form logic.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Ownership, whitespace definitions and validation without mutation transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Primitive strings and ordinary data objects keep the scope explicit.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Inherited blank fields or silent rewriting can give wrong validation outcomes.

defects: The junior for-in loop included inherited fields while reference/senior used own Object.values.
Stored-value trimming and ASCII-space-only checks passed the original suite.
Non-enumerable/symbol exclusions and JavaScript whitespace boundaries were unspecified.
rationale: Define only own enumerable string-keyed fields and exact trim whitespace, including tabs/NBSP/BOM and excluding zero-width space. Junior now loops over Object.values too. Inherited blank, hidden/symbol blank, whitespace-only, zero-width content, frozen null-prototype and unchanged stored-text fixtures cover the clarified policy. Existing empty-form=true behavior stays intact. Linear cost includes property inspection and total string length rather than treating arbitrary trim work as constant.
